column1: # Template for the next allocation (scripts/campaign.sh replaces {R}). Plan (10-22 12:20, user: requeue away from n02-25,
# whose GPU is stuck): canonical 3600 s rounds on ONE deployment, to answer why prefill MTP + weight 0 measured below
# crsuse2's throughput (1800 s windows understate tok/s/GPU by ~6%): the unmodified PR 210 kit (aab4cc36) as the repro,
# then the prefill restarted with the decode's EAGLE flags on GPUs 0-3 (weight 0), then weight 1,000,000.
run pr210/kit_round.sh RUN=k{R}r VARIANT=k{R}-repro CONC=88 ROUTER=image
run pr210/kit_restart_prefill.sh RUN=k{R}r TAG=nomtp GPUS=0,1,2,3 MTP=1
run pr210/kit_round.sh RUN=k{R}r VARIANT=k{R}-pmtp-w0 CONC=88 ROUTER=exp WEIGHT=0
run pr210/kit_round.sh RUN=k{R}r VARIANT=k{R}-pmtp-w1m CONC=88 ROUTER=exp WEIGHT=1000000
